nodes.label: Analytics
nodes.rationale: Gross profit counts goods at cost when sold; inventory purchases shown as cash spent but not subtracted; stock losses at cost reduce net profit

nodes.label: Cash Advances
nodes.rationale: Treated as a receivable, not an expense; one open per employee, repaid via pay-run deduction

nodes.label: Print Day Summary (X-reading)
nodes.rationale: Resets nothing and is explicitly not an official receipt nor a BIR Z-reading

nodes.label: Expenses
nodes.rationale: Never deleted: voided with a reason and every edit logged (audit trail)

nodes.label: Export Sales (CSV/Excel)
nodes.rationale: Uses price/cost at time of sale; voids listed separately and excluded; totals after discounts so they match Analytics; styles post-processed because free SheetJS cannot write styles

nodes.label: Inventory
nodes.rationale: Stock only changes through receive/count/write-off actions, each logged in product History with who made it

nodes.label: Payroll
nodes.rationale: Finalizing a pay run posts salaries and employer contributions to Expenses; voiding the run voids them

nodes.label: robots noindex, nofollow
nodes.rationale: Staff-only app, kept out of search engines.

nodes.label: Numbered SQL Patches (001-021)
nodes.rationale: Each patch is idempotent (safe to run again); applied in order after schema.sql

nodes.label: Staff Roles (admin, staff, inactive)
nodes.rationale: Public sign-up disabled; new accounts start inactive so only admins grant access; always at least one admin

nodes.label: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server only)
nodes.rationale: Never prefixed VITE_ or committed; used only by server functions that verify caller role

nodes.label: Check-in (QR door scan)
nodes.rationale: Only a fast scanner burst counts so normal typing never checks anyone in; visits logged once per 10 minutes

nodes.label: Memberships & Plans
nodes.rationale: Plans are services without stock, so live in Members > Plans rather than Inventory; days are added after current end date or from today if lapsed; voiding reverses

nodes.label: PWA Icon 192x192
nodes.description: 192px downscale of the CouRageD logo on black; standard PWA manifest icon.

nodes.label: PWA Maskable Icon 512x512
nodes.description: 512px CouRageD logo shrunk inside a black safe-zone padding.
nodes.rationale: Extra padding keeps the mark inside the maskable safe zone so Android adaptive icon masks (circle/squircle) do not crop it.

nodes.label: PWA Icon 512x512
nodes.description: 512px full-bleed CouRageD logo; standard large PWA manifest icon / splash.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon
nodes.description: Small (~180px) CouRageD logo on black for iOS home-screen install.

nodes.label: CouRageD Brand Logo
nodes.description: Square master logo on black: gold/yellow illustrated muscular man and woman (woman holding a dumbbell, gym/fitness theme) above red brush-script 'CouRageD' wordmark with white outline.

nodes.label: PWA Install Icons
nodes.rationale: Icon set (192, 512, 512 maskable, apple-touch) required for installable PWA across Android, desktop and iOS.
